svg.title: The layers of the AI-readable system
svg.desc: Five layers from rules at the top to guards at the bottom: CLAUDE.md rules, intents, registry and Figma map, specs, and guards.

g.text: CLAUDE.md · build-from-design skill: never invent values, fix components not pages, log deviations
ai/intents.json · ai/patterns.md: what a region looks like -> which components, page recipes (written by hand)
ai/components.json · ai/figma-map.json: props, defaults, demos, Figma set -> component (generated)
figma-tokens/pulse/*.json: every variant, size, colour, text style, read from the .fig (generated)
